channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Pioneer (northwalespioneer.co.uk)

item.title: Listed Conwy gothic villa hotel dating back to 19th century could become home
item.description: A hotel in Conwy located at the site of a 19th century gothic villa could be converted into a home after a planning application was lodged.

item.title: 'Buffer speed limits' to be introduced on main roads in Conwy - this is where
item.description: Buffer speed limits will be introduced on two main roads in Conwy county, Welsh Government have confirmed.

item.title: Police warning after car thefts reported from outside homes in North Wales
item.description: North Wales Police are investigating a series of Audi thefts and are urging vehicle owners to take extra security precautions.

item.title: Drivers warned by North Wales police after almost 50 offences spotted in five days
item.description: Using an unmarked heavy goods vehicle, officers from the Roads Crime Unit took part in Op Tramline – a national roads policing operation using a HGV tractor unit provided by National Highways.

item.title: USA man crosses Atlantic for Welsh exam and castle‑hopping in Conwy and Gwynedd
item.description: An American language enthusiast who flew 4,000 miles to sit a Welsh exam has been exploring Conwy and Gwynedd’s castles along the way, after spending more than a year teaching himself the language from his home in Mississippi.

item.title: Lucky North Wales nan scoops £10k a month for a year on National Lottery
item.description: She has won £10,000 every month for a year through the National Lottery Set for Life draw

item.title: When to expect snow across North Wales according to the Met Office
item.description: The organisation has put a weather warning in place too

item.title: New railway station to be built in North Wales as part of Welsh investment
item.description: It comes as part of a major investment in Wales' rail network

item.title: Conwy Council plans 6.5% council tax rise as bills set to break £2,000 barrier
item.description: Conwy County Council is proposing a 6.5% council tax rise to help fill a £7.9m budget shortfall — pushing a band D bill above £2,000 for the first time. Critics say residents are facing yet another “record-breaking” increase.

item.title: Bridge set to close as council announces resurfacing work
item.description: A bridge is set to close for resurfacing work.
